description:
Spring registration jar for franca-thinking-retrieval: the deep
        research thinking implementation's auto-configuration and its
        META-INF AutoConfiguration.imports marker. Assembly only — the
        phase lives in the pure module; a Spring Boot host pulls this
        jar in and the RetrievalPhase bean registers into the platform
        assembler's ThinkingPhaseRegistry slot, with no Spring code in
        the pure half.
